exactDocument.pathShape: one M plus one non-collinear cubic C verb per path

shardIndex.strategy: 64x64 fixed world grid; path i belongs to cell i mod 4096

jsonRoundTrip.format: 4096 independently parseable compact JSON shards; each path record retains all M+C geometry, width, and RGB fields
jsonRoundTrip.reason: bounded shard JSON is the persistence/deployment shape; no path is omitted and counts are summed after parsing every shard

interaction.strategy: query intersecting 256px cells, exact conservative cubic bounds test, lower visible records only to a 512x512 SceneIR island

releaseGate.scope: exact 100k/1M document integrity and bounded pan/zoom interaction; does not claim a monolithic 1M all-visible frame
